terminal_reason: FIX-CA-12 fixed in PR #13246: 9 diag venue routes return 503 accounts_unreadable / 404 unknown_account_id instead of 200 accounts:[]; detector tests/test_diag_accounts_unreadable.py (25 cases, all fail on main 7d002927).
what: HIGH (code audit AUD-20260927-CA-A08-diag-venue-reads-collapse-could-not-look): Nine token-gated venue-truth diag routes (exchange_positions, venue_session, ib_open_orders, broker_account_status, bybit_open_orders, bybit_raw_order_history, bybit_raw_closed_pnl, bybit_raw_positions, alpaca_open_orders) answer HTTP 200 with accounts:[] (and ib_open_orders count:0) when list_accounts() raises OR when the requested account_id matches nothing, so 'could not look / wrong account id' is byte-identical to 'looked, venue holds nothing'. PROPOSED FIX: In each route: on list_accounts failure return 503 {'error':'accounts_unreadable'} (the file already 503s on import failure two lines above); when account_id is given and no configured account matches, return 404 {'error':'unknown_account_id'}; set count to None when no account was read. Make _load_yaml_accounts surface its errors list to callers.
